name: Replica
source:
Replica is an interactive novel game played through a cellphone and social media. The insane experience of peeping into someone's private life through a cellphone will transform you into the state's greatest patriot.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/496890/Replica/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
Replica是一款通过手机和社交媒体玩的互动小说游戏。通过手机窥视他人私生活的疯狂经历将使你成为该州最伟大的爱国者。

[来自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/496890/Replica/]Steam[/url]]
